skill.name: invoice-organizer
skill.description: Organizes invoices and receipts by extracting key details, standardizing filenames, sorting files, and creating summary reports for bookkeeping.
skill.summary: Turn mixed invoices and receipts into organized folders and accountant-ready summaries.

content.value_statement: Invoice folders often contain unclear filenames and mixed receipt formats. This skill extracts key details, renames files, organizes folders, and creates accountant-ready summaries.
actual_capabilities: Extracts vendor, date, invoice number, amount, and description from invoices and receipts.
Renames files with a consistent date, vendor, document type, and description format.
Sorts documents by vendor, expense category, date period, or tax category.
Creates CSV summaries with invoice details and organized file paths.
Flags unclear documents for manual review when key information is missing.
Preserves originals by recommending copy-first workflows before file moves.
limitations: Extraction quality depends on readable text, clear scans, and complete invoice details.
The skill does not provide tax, legal, or accounting advice.
Bulk file changes should be reviewed before approval and backed up first.
Unusual layouts, duplicates, and split invoices may need manual correction.

use_cases.title: Prepare Tax Records
use_cases.description: Convert a messy folder of invoices into dated folders and a summary for tax review.

use_cases.title: Reconcile Monthly Expenses
use_cases.description: Group recent receipts by category and create a simple expense summary for review.

use_cases.title: Clean Downloaded Invoices
use_cases.description: Rename repeated download filenames with real vendor, date, and service details.

prompt_templates.title: Organize Basic Invoice Folder
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a single messy folder.
prompt_templates.prompt: Organize the invoices in this folder for tax preparation. Keep originals safe, rename copies clearly, and create a simple summary.

prompt_templates.title: Sort Receipts by Category
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for monthly expense review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Read these receipts, extract vendor, date, amount, and description, then organize them by expense category with a summary for review.

prompt_templates.title: Build Accountant Package
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for tax or bookkeeping handoff.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an accountant-ready invoice archive by year, category, and vendor. Include a CSV summary with paths and flag uncertain documents.

prompt_templates.title: Design Ongoing Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a reusable process.
prompt_templates.prompt: Propose a safe monthly invoice organization workflow for my downloads folder. Include naming rules, review steps, and backup guidance before automation.

output_examples.input: A folder contains 89 files named invoice, invoice one, and receipt image files.
output: Files are renamed with dates, vendors, document types, and short descriptions.
Documents are sorted into vendor or category folders.
A review list identifies files with missing dates or unclear totals.

output_examples.input: A business owner needs March receipts grouped for bookkeeping.
output: Receipts are grouped by software, office, travel, meals, and services.
A monthly total is summarized for each category.
A CSV summary is prepared for accounting software import.

output_examples.input: Three years of invoices need a searchable archive.
output: Invoices are organized by year and vendor.
Files use consistent names for sorting and search.
Duplicates and incomplete documents are called out for review.

best_practices: Review the proposed file plan before approving any copy or move operations.
Keep original invoices backed up until the organized archive is verified.
Use one consistent naming pattern across all years and vendors.
anti_patterns: Do not approve bulk moves before checking the proposed destination folders.
Do not treat extracted tax categories as professional tax advice.
Do not delete originals until summaries and organized copies are verified.

faq.question: Can it organize scanned receipts?
faq.answer: Yes. It can use readable text from images and flag unclear scans for manual review.

faq.question: Does it change my original files?
faq.answer: The workflow recommends copying files first and preserving originals unless you approve moves.

faq.question: Can it create a spreadsheet for my accountant?
faq.answer: Yes. It can create a CSV summary with invoice details, categories, amounts, and file paths.

faq.question: Does it decide what is tax deductible?
faq.answer: No. It can group documents by requested categories, but it does not provide tax advice.

faq.question: What happens when details are missing?
faq.answer: It can use filename or file date clues and place uncertain documents in a review list.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude Code or Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill is written for Claude, Claude Code, and Codex workflows.
